articles.title: a16z Drops Crypto From Its Name, Widens Bets to AI and Frontier Tech
articles.description: Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund a16z Frontier and widening its scope to AI, autonomous machines and biology, saying the line between crypto and everyday tech has blurred.

articles.title: Reported fraud losses among older Americans hit $3 billion in 2025 as big losses surge: FTC report
articles.description: Older Americans reported $2.1 billion in fraud losses of at least $100,000, accounting for 70% of the $3 billion lost overall, according to the FTC.

articles.title: Elon Musk invests about $1 billion in Skydance
articles.description: David Ellison's father, billionaire and Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, has a history with Musk.

articles.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad with Acton's estranged mom after bipartisan criticism
articles.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine said GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy should remove the ad featuring the mother of Democratic nominee Amy Acton.

articles.title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy
articles.description: While crypto-aligned PACs have stepped up spending in Ohio, a committee launched by the co-founders of crypto exchange Gemini made one of its first forays into the Lone Star State.

articles.title: Moderna shares plunge after leak of cancer vaccine data despite positive results
articles.description: Moderna's stock fell even though the full data, released later Thursday, appeared positive based on Wall Street expectations ahead of the release.

articles.title: Brent crude tops $113, highest level since May, after Trump hints at action on Iran
articles.description: The Middle East conflict could flare up again as the U.S. reportedly plans to resume strikes against Iran.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns
articles.description: Musk’s biggest political bet is on the Senate, where control could shape future investigations, federal spending and regulations affecting SpaceX and Tesla.

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.description: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

articles.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
articles.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

articles.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
articles.description: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

articles.title: Pepsi renews contract with Taco Bell days after KFC switches to Coke in the U.S.
articles.description: Taco Bell is sticking with longtime beverage supplier PepsiCo, even though sister chain KFC defected to Coca-Cola.

articles.title: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, charged in marijuana racketeering case
articles.description: The investigation into the Democrat predates the current Trump administration. But the timing of the indictment before the midterms has raised eyebrows.

articles.title: Coinbase Fined Again in Ireland, This Time $3.6M Over Fund Safeguarding
articles.description: The Central Bank of Ireland penalized Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for leaning too heavily on its U.S. parent and leaving its safeguarding account underfunded—its second hit to the exchange’s European arm in the last year.

articles.title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
articles.description: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

articles.title: The perfect storm behind the Nasdaq's rout — plus, some of the bright spots in the market

articles.title: AI debt and French bonds face a stress test — why it may not be over
articles.description: Bond markets are signaling unease over AI financing costs and sovereign debt in parts of Europe. More stress tests are coming.

articles.title: Tesla's Profit Drops 43% as Musk Starts Building Robots and Plans to Sell Driverless Cabs
articles.description: Tesla earned $787 million last quarter, down from $1.37 billion, as spending on robots and self-driving cars soared. Optimus is in production, and Tesla aims to get Cybercabs to customers by year-end.

articles.title: Bill Ackman says 2027 will be an amazing year for stocks as wars, inflation ease
